_docs: Defaults for the POC-2 rule engine (D-08: deterministic rulebook, thresholds configurable). Every threshold below documents its source in _sources. This file is the baked-in default config; loadConfig(configPath) deep-merges an optional user override file on top of this one.

_sources.titleMinChars: Screaming Frog SEO Spider default 'Page Titles' min length filter (30 chars)
_sources.titleMaxChars: Screaming Frog SEO Spider default 'Page Titles' max length filter (60 chars)
_sources.titleMaxPx: Screaming Frog default max pixel width for title (~561px desktop Google SERP truncation estimate)
_sources.descMinChars: Screaming Frog default 'Meta Description' min length filter (70 chars)
_sources.descMaxChars: Screaming Frog default 'Meta Description' max length filter (155 chars)
_sources.descMaxPx: Screaming Frog default max pixel width for meta description (~985px desktop Google SERP truncation estimate)
_sources.thinContentWords: POC threshold (brief §6b seeds): chosen to cleanly separate the seeded thin-content fixture (/blog/trail-snacks, 35 words) from normal site copy (100+ words); below common full-suite editorial guidance of 300+ words
_sources.lowTextRatio: General SEO-tooling guidance range for low text-to-HTML ratio (10-25%); no single canonical Screaming Frog figure, documented POC judgment call at the low end
_sources.slowPageMs: Brief §6b seed default (2000ms); matches commonly-cited informal 'slow page' response-time bucket used by SEO crawlers
_sources.redirectChainMax: Screaming Frog 'Redirect Chains' report flags any chain longer than 1 hop
_sources.nearDupWordCountDeltaPct: DEPRECATED (slice C3): superseded by nearDupSimilarity, a real MinHash/Jaccard score. Left as-is, no longer read by near-duplicate-content.
_sources.nearDupSimilarity: slice C3: 5-word-shingle MinHash+LSH estimated Jaccard threshold. 0.75, not the originally-planned 0.9 -- the seeded near-dup fixture pair (/blog/winter-hiking-checklist vs /blog/winter-day-hike-checklist, manifest #18) measures ~0.824 true Jaccard at shingle size 5, so 0.9 would silently miss it; 0.75 leaves margin below that measurement while staying well above the near-zero overlap unrelated same-length pages produce.
_sources.weakInlinkCount: spec.md A4 scope: pages with exactly 1 inlink are 'weakly-linked'
